summary: Addresses environmental impact review for data centers. Passed the Senate 29-8 and the Assembly 42-10 and awaits the Governor's signature or veto by the end of September 2026.

source.citation: Office of Senator Steve Padilla release; datacenterbans.com

notes: Sits directly on top of the Imperial County Superior Court ruling this month halting a nearly one-million-square-foot complex approved without review under the California Environmental Quality Act. A court voided a project for skipping review in the same month the Legislature sent the Governor a bill on the same subject.
confidence_note: Bill text not read. What the bill requires, and whether it changes CEQA's application to data centers or adds a separate review, is NOT_CHECKED. No relationship between the bill and the Imperial County ruling is asserted beyond their concurrence in time.
